item: Row 66 part 2: the publication time a page states is kept (UTC), and a date filter's end day includes the whole day
summary: Field report 2026-11-14: about 94% of stored times were midnight. htmldate now returns time and offset, trafilatura's date-only max_date (read as today 00:00, which cut today's times) is dropped, aware values are stored as naive UTC; a date-only end bound is now < next day. Stored day is the UTC day; no-offset times stored as stated; JSON-LD date-only stays midnight. New articles only.
